description.value:
You have incredibly well-tuned senses tuned to detect fresh blood in an instant. Within 15ft, you automatically detect and are considered to have blindsight vision on any @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.R54LQEKSDXNQ3N75]{Bleeding} creatures. Furthermore, you can detect any spilled blood fresher than a day old, and can immediately sense when a creature within range takes damage that would draw blood, such as from slashing or piercing damage.
While underwater, your Bloodsense range is doubled.
